definition.name: Compile exact Rust context utility and owned thread sysroot

steps.name: Install existing pinned Python compiler recipe dependencies
Prepare the existing captured compiler isolation and binding tool
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Build the two exact owned compiler inputs once
steps.run:
arguments=()
if [ "$APPLICATION_DIAGNOSTIC" = true ]; then
  arguments+=(--application-diagnostic)
fi
python3 -B tools/compile_rust_owned_thread_inputs.py \
  --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD" \
  --rust-bin "$(dirname "$(rustup which rustc)")" \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-owned-thread-inputs" "${arguments[@]}"

steps.name: Retain bounded source, tool, sysroot and actual failure logs

reviewReason: Reviewed security fork identities only; commands, permissions, inputs, conditions and historical coverage are preserved.
